scope.statement: The Gauna pack reuses the bounded chapter-54 Kamika mahatmya but finds no Gauna calculation rule or separate Gauna story in it. A future owner should preserve the nested dialogue, absence of developed origin story, sensitive source language and distinction between fixed source context and current calendar authority.
